subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

SENTIMENT
solution:
The correct answer is '**Feeling**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Sentiment**' is '**Feeling**'.
 
• **Sentiment**: feelings such as pity, romantic love, sadness, etc. that influence somebody’s action or behaviour (sometimes in situations where this is not appropriate). [करुणा, रूमानी प्रेम, विषाद आदि भाव (जिनका व्‍यक्ति के कार्य या आचरण पर प्रभाव पड़ता है जो कभी-कभी प्रसंग-विशेष में अनुपयुक्त लगता है)]
 
 
• *Example: There’s no room for **sentiment** in business.*
 
 
 
• **Feeling**: something that you feel in your mind or body. (शरीर या मन की अनुभूति; अहसास, भावना)
 
 
• *Example: I’ve got a funny **feeling** in my leg.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Feeling.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Antipathy**: a strong feeling of not liking somebody/something; dislike. (प्रतिकूलता की प्रबल भावना; नापसंदगी, चिढ़, विद्वेष)
 
• **Concrete**: real or definite; not only existing in the imagination. [यथार्थ प्रत्‍यक्ष, ठोस; मूर्त (काल्‍पनिक नहीं)]
 
• **Hatred**: a very strong feeling of not liking somebody/something; hate. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए अत्‍यधिक नापसंदगी का भाव; घृणा)
